optional_adapter_network_requirements.prometheus: Read-only outbound HTTP to a Prometheus server (opt-in).
optional_adapter_network_requirements.shadow: Read-only Kubernetes API access to watch HPA/state for shadow comparison (opt-in).
optional_adapter_network_requirements.otel: Outbound OTLP export to a collector (opt-in).

known_limitations: Advisory-only: produces recommendations; does not actuate infrastructure.
Not live-cluster validated by this package; not production-certified.

identity_deviation is a pre-existing nondeterministic observability output (unseeded IdentityEMA baseline); it does not affect any scaling decision and is excluded from the behavior-baseline parity projection.
No cost-savings, customer-validation, or real-cluster-superiority claims are made.
The shadow/action operational modules ship as opt-in, non-default legacy modules behind extras; no write-capable executor is wired to or invoked by the advisory core.
